sentences.text:
Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr F Z Mazumder
Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam
Page No.# 2/3 Before Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund 22.03.2023
1.

Heard Mr. F.Z Mazumdar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as Mr. B. B.
Gogoi, learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State respondent.
Also heard Mr. M. Khan, learned Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104338911/

2. The petitioner, namely, Subir Choudhury and Anu Choudhury have filed this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C with prayer for pre-arrest bail as they are apprehending arrest in connection with Silchar P.S. Case No. 2666/2022, under Section 417/376/328/385/506 IPC.
3. I have considered the submissions at the Bar.

4. The FIR unfolds that the petitioner no. 1 was acquainted with the informant's husband and so the informant too got acquainted with the petitioner no. 1, who borrowed the Rs. 50,000/- from her initially.

Thereafter, on one occasion the petitioner no. 1 administered spiked cold drink to the informant and clicked obscene photographs and started threatening the informant to circulate the obscene pictures and videos through social media and other media and with such threats the petitioner no. 2 also helped her husband and thereafter, they threatened the informant with dire consequences.
5. I have considered the submissions at the Bar and I have perused the case diary.
It is submitted at the Bar that no case under Section 376 IPC is made out against both the petitioners.
No case under Section 328 IPC is also made out against both the petitioners.
It is submitted that the offence which is alleged against the petitioners are bailable offences and the petitioners deserve bail.
6. The case diary reveals that the investigation has progressed to a considerable extent and custodial interrogation may not be necessary at this stage.
7. Considering the submissions at the Bar and in view of my foregoing discussions, I deem it proper to grant pre-arrest bail to both the petitioners.

8. In the event of arrest of the petitioners, they shall be enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/-
Page No.# 3/3 each with a suitable surety each of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, under conditions that,
(i) the petitioners will not exercise threats to the witnesses and will not tamper with the evidence,
and (ii) the petitioners will appear before the I/O within 7(seven) days and co- operate with the investigation.
Send back the case diary.
